name: pointlio-baseline-2026-09-09
stop: Ctrl+C; owned processes stop and results transfer to laptop after SHA256 verification
backend: Point-LIO gyro-only output model; raw L1 and LiDAR gyro; no legs, acceleration integration, camera or loop closure

images.note: Jetson tested image includes optional Leg-KILO; baseline invokes Point-LIO. Tags are local, not registry-published. No additional image copies created.

limits: One live return test (~3 cm), not whole-map accuracy or long-route guarantee.
Nominal extrinsics and gyro calibration remain limitations.
Package repositories in Dockerfile are not completely locked; rebuilding source is not guaranteed to produce identical image bytes. Preserve recorded local image IDs for exact binary reproduction.
Unreleased Leg-KILO export-tail patch remains outside this Git checkpoint.

validation.test_command: ROS Humble: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
